title: Get Dashboard Running End to End
description: Get the dashboard running end to end. Build fails because ui/tui Theme still references removed ChromePalette fields after the 6-level UI surface system. Fix TUI theme, rebuild repo_cli, confirm dashboard runs.
summary: Unblocked the semio TUI dashboard end to end. Root cause: ui/tui Theme still mapped the pre-6-level ChromePalette fields (canvas/window/panel/hover_window/hover_panel/temporary), so cargo build -p repo_cli failed and bun ./🧰️framework/🛍️product/🦑️repo/🔨️module/⌨️cli/⚡️implementation/🦀️rust/📜️script.ts run could not produce the binary. Migrated Theme/Surface/Role onto the unified 6-level palette (level_base→level_menu + hover_interactive_fill), pointed ChromeState::Canvas at Surface::Base, and cleaned unused Duration qualifications. Also fixed string_array_field so TOML string arrays no longer inject the interstitial ", " token (assets_blocks_parse_all_kinds). Verified: ui_tui 77/77, repo_cli 13/13, release build succeeds, PTY smoke paints navbar/dev/build windows with Plugin/React/Wgpu/Examples and quits on q.
note: ticket MCP CallMcpTool failed (process client not registered); ticket folder managed manually.
